mostWorthwhile.text: Following cold skin circulation with skeletal muscle was most worthwhile: the planned pictures distinguish reduced heat loss from heat production and connect shivering to ATP use.

leastWorthwhile.text: The repeated sensing-to-vessel sequence felt predictable, especially because each decision offered only one combination. The hypothalamus was named but its role in coordinating the responses could be explained more explicitly.

surprise.text: The fading sweat signal as temperature moved toward its earlier range made the feedback response more apparent than simply showing sweat evaporating.

arbitrary.text: No action lacked a clear purpose, though the sole compatible option at each step meant I was following a prescribed route rather than deciding which response to build.

continue.text: I would probably not continue: the warm and cold comparison was useful, but the single-option sequence offered little meaningful choice.
